title: Infrastructure outputs
description: infra/envs/poc/outputs.json, written by workstream 1 after every apply. The scripts and the deployed tests read it, and none of them reads Terraform state. Workstream 1 proposes this contract; the integrator writes it. Source: docs/plan/02-contracts.md -> Infrastructure outputs. Freezes at G1a.

region.description: The AWS region. Every price in the cost model is for us-east-1.

cell.description: The cell name, the same value as Platform:Cell. It is part of every resource name and of the data-protection application name, so it takes the same lexical form as an appId.

bucket.description: The one private bucket: the registry and every release.

albDnsName.description: The internal load balancer's DNS name. The tunnel forwards to it.

ecrGateway.description: The gateway image repository, with immutable tags.

ecrMockApi.description: The mock API image repository, with immutable tags.

gatewayImage.description: The running gateway image, pinned by digest. Deployment pushes by digest and then asserts the running one, so a tag never decides what runs. The digest in the example document is abbreviated to eight hex characters; a real one has sixty-four.

issuer.description: The identity provider's issuer, the value behind Issuers:{name}:Authority.

cognitoDomain.description: The managed-login prefix domain, host only and no scheme. Issuers:{name}:BrowserOrigin is https:// plus this value.

clients.description: One entry per app that has an OAuth client, keyed by appId. spactl app add reads it to complete an app definition.

secretParameter.description: The Parameter Store name holding the client secret. Never the value: this file is written to the repository's working tree and read by scripts.

secretVersion.description: The parameter version. A rotation raises it, and the registry entry's clientSecretRef follows.

testUsers.description: The pool's test users, keyed by user name. Each names the parameter its generated password lives in, never the password.

logGroup.description: The task's CloudWatch log group. The deployed tests read the gateway log for a run from here.
